model.feature_order_source: models/v_win_trees.txt; aligned to E2c columns by name

q1.silver_reference_note: Silver scores are search points; comparison treats +1 post-battle HP as one point.
q1.split_gain_note: The tracked compact model stores split indices and thresholds but no gain values; total gain is unavailable.

q2.conclusion: No reviewed intervention directly identifies v_win's causal HP slope.

existing_interventional_evidence_review.finding: The trainer reports model-space P(win) changes after increasing curHp by 30% of maxHp, clamped to maxHp, stratified by HP band.
existing_interventional_evidence_review.reason: It is a synthetic feature perturbation of the fitted model, not a held-out outcome intervention or a matched native continuation.

existing_interventional_evidence_review.finding: Verified repository path trains on paired downstream gate-score differences for out-of-combat actions.
existing_interventional_evidence_review.reason: Rest-versus-upgrade jointly changes HP and progression; it identifies an action contrast, not a controlled HP derivative of this classifier.

existing_interventional_evidence_review.finding: Verified terminal bonus experiment was null on win rate and cost 3.1x at the recorded setup.
existing_interventional_evidence_review.reason: It intervenes on the search policy by adding a tree bonus; it does not perturb terminal HP while holding the other state fixed.
Route branches alter path, rewards, and later states together; they do not isolate terminal HP.

existing_interventional_evidence_review.finding: No repository artifact found that resumes matched captured states under only an HP offset.
existing_interventional_evidence_review.reason: A controlled continuation intervention remains to be run in a separate authorized study.

historical_split_claim_review.artifact_caveat: The tracked model file matches the original exported build/v_win_trees.txt blob, but the exact model artifact used for the historical §109-110 run is not provenance-bound there. Do not rewrite that historical run's result from this audit.
historical_split_claim_review.current_enum_correction: r116 is Neow's Lament; r131 is Thread and Needle.
historical_split_claim_review.feature_encoding_source: apps/one_combat/run_features.cpp:90-94 encodes relic fields as 1 + counter when present; thresholds above 1.0 therefore distinguish counter values for counter relics.
historical_split_claim_review.finding: The current tracked 1060-tree artifact has counter-value thresholds above 1.0 on multiple relic features; the historical zero-split statement does not describe this tracked artifact.

proposed_test.cost_basis: Inference: 96 x 38 CPU-s per continuation using the §340 approx 38 CPU-s/run reference; exact replay cost is unmeasured.
proposed_test.execution: seed_guard.sh only; do not execute as part of this audit

q3_calibration.warning: 128 run seeds provide weak calibration power; rows within a seed are correlated.

delta_probability_regression.coefficient_interpretation: descriptive conditional on this cohort's observed potion-capacity mix; potionCount and slot slack are fit simultaneously as preregistered after capacities 3 and 5 were observed.

q5.classification: E2c T-fair HIDDEN_FUTURE set; bossId retained as observable/trackable
q5.out_of_distribution_caveat: Zeroing hidden future fields is the specified offline fallback, not the historical resampling substitute; these feature combinations may be out of distribution.

q6.latency_method: Release -O3/-DNDEBUG direct CompactTreeNet::predict call on the same native class used by g_winNet; 20,000-call per-call timings.
q6.scope_note: potionCapacity varies across runs (3 and 5 observed) but is not changed during BattleContext::exitBattle (copied into BattleContext at third_party/silver_lightspeed/src/combat/BattleContext.cpp:47 and omitted from its exit transfer at :488-502); static progression, hidden-future, path, and bottled-card features are unchanged between victorious endings of one combat.

within_combat_vwin_inputs.reason: combat HP is copied to GameContext and victory relics can heal at exit
Feed raises max HP when it kills a qualifying non-minion
Hand of Greed can add gold during combat; combat gold is copied on exit
consumed potion slots and their potion IDs are copied from BattleContext
Writhing Mass can add Parasite at exit; richRow derives deckSize and per-card counts
exitBattle updates these relic counters/removals and their richRow r{id} values

verdict.scope: W1 input readiness only; no gameplay or runtime promotion claim.
